task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick up the blue and white playingcards packaging and move it away.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。机械臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架拾取蓝白纸牌包装并移走。
